test_title: PYST 7: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 11 Oct 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'ALMOND' is coded as 4-48-52-60-56-16 and 'SHEEP' is coded as 76-32-20-20-64. How will 'CASHEW' be coded in the same language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6a90b1438ad6309ccb9989532cf58e8ca7d690b2f0748b87e4c7dfefd540779.png] ​

**Logic: 'Positional value of the letters is multiplied by 4'**

**Given:**

'ALMOND' is coded as '4-48-52-60-56-16' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05f5dd3a71089811f841ad36457f39d0b34c8ee512afcf022e40f435abaa649b.png] 

'SHEEP' is coded as '76-32-20-20-64' →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/98012ebe22c759e1bfd9d85fff76d19ca6fbd8a2d195be91a9e96dd9ade3ac3a.png] 

Similarly, 'CASHEW' will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/847592f18391c23408c2ae741e10db41720a8f050a35c21b5ffcaa772833d161.png] 

Here, 'CASHEW' is coded as **'12-4-76-32-20-92'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
